","documentario-dj":""};
const AC_TITLES={"index":"Início","projetos":"Projetos","bio-extratus":"Bio Extratus","batekoo":"BATEKOO","documentario-dj":"E eu não sou uma DJ?","publicacoes":"Publicações","videos":"Vídeos","musica":"Lado B","sobre":"Sobre"};
const frame=document.getElementById('ac-screen');
const loading=document.getElementById('ac-loading');
const cache=new Map();
const decoder=new TextDecoder('utf-8');
let currentPage='';
let initialLoading=true;
let loadingStartedAt=performance.now();
let revealTimer=null;
function revealLoading(){
  if(!initialLoading){loading.classList.add('hidden');return;}
  const elapsed=performance.now()-loadingStartedAt;
  clearTimeout(revealTimer);
  revealTimer=setTimeout(()=>{loading.classList.add('hidden');initialLoading=false;},Math.max(0,1800-elapsed));
}
function htmlFor(page,anchor){
  if(!cache.has(page)){
    const binary=atob(AC_PAGES[page]);
    const bytes=new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for(let i=0;i<binary.length;i++)bytes[i]=binary.charCodeAt(i);
    cache.set(page,decoder.decode(bytes));
  }
  return cache.get(page).replace('__ANCHOR_PLACEHOLDER__',String(anchor||'').replace(/[\"<>]/g,''));
}
function getRoute(){
  const hash=decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(2));
  if(!location.hash.startsWith('#/'))return {page:'index',anchor:''};
  const slash=hash.indexOf('/');
  const p=(slash<0?hash:hash.slice(0,slash)).replace(/\.html$/,'');
  const anchor=slash<0?'':hash.slice(slash+1);
  return {page:Object.hasOwn(AC_PAGES,p)?p:'index',anchor};
}
function mountRoute(){
  const {page,anchor}=getRoute();
  clearTimeout(revealTimer);
  loadingStartedAt=performance.now();
  loading.classList.remove('hidden');
  currentPage=page;
  document.title=(AC_TITLES[page]||'Início')+' | Alicia Coura';
  frame.title='Alicia Coura: '+(AC_TITLES[page]||'Início');
  frame.srcdoc=htmlFor(page,anchor);
  // A fonte ou um player externo não deve prender a navegação na tela de carregamento.
  setTimeout(()=>{if(currentPage===page)revealLoading()},initialLoading?3000:1200);
}

function openDocumentaryPlayer(){
  const dialog=document.getElementById('ac-doc-dialog');
  const player=document.getElementById('ac-doc-player');
  if(!dialog||!player)return;
  const iframe=document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.width='560';
  iframe.height='315';
  iframe.title='YouTube video player | E eu não sou uma DJ?';
  iframe.src='https://www.youtube.com/embed/H2gN1gkJ2kU?si=RdlBLyvTAhmuPWe1';
  iframe.setAttribute('allow','accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share');
  iframe.referrerPolicy='strict-origin-when-cross-origin';
  iframe.allowFullscreen=true;
  iframe.setAttribute('loading','eager');
  player.replaceChildren(iframe);
  if(!dialog.open)dialog.showModal();
  dialog.querySelector('[data-ac-doc-close]')?.focus();
}
(()=>{
 const dialog=document.getElementById('ac-doc-dialog');
 if(!dialog)return;
 const close=()=>dialog.close();
 dialog.querySelector('[data-ac-doc-close]')?.addEventListener('click',close);
 dialog.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===dialog)close()});
 dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>document.getElementById('ac-doc-player')?.replaceChildren());
})();

function routeTo(page,anchor){
  if(!Object.hasOwn(AC_PAGES,page))return;
  const route='#/'+page+(anchor?'/'+encodeURIComponent(anchor):'');
  if(location.hash===route)mountRoute();else location.hash=route;
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange',mountRoute);
window.addEventListener('message',e=>{
  if(e.source!==frame.contentWindow || !e.data || e.data.acSingleViewer!==true)return;
  if(e.data.action==='playDocumentary' && currentPage==='documentario-dj')openDocumentaryPlayer();
  if(e.data.action==='navigate')routeTo(e.data.page,e.data.anchor);
  if(e.data.action==='ready'&&e.data.page===currentPage)revealLoading();
});
frame.addEventListener('load',()=>{setTimeout(revealLoading,initialLoading?120:180)});
if(!location.hash.startsWith('#/')){history.replaceState(null,'',location.href.split('#')[0]+'#/index')}
mountRoute();
</script></body></html>
